description: An omission with no constituent: [T] follows the terminal A, so the prefix is the item before [T]. On A T, that item reads the written T as [T], so leaving it out is forbidden, and r cannot read the token as its last T. begins of r is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text A T
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r A [+T] T
